sentences.sentence: A star during most of its life is a main-sequence star, which consists of a core, radiative and convective zones, a photosphere, a chromosphere and a corona.

sentences.sentence: It weakens fundamental systems, it distorts markets, and it encourages people to apply their skills and energies in nonproductive ways.

sentences.sentence: This suggests a huge portion of the credit stimulus has been wasted on nonproductive investments, which in turn has implications for how much of that lending would ever be repaid.

sentences.sentence: One of the criminals immediately shoved a .38 caliber handgun to my head, ordered me to the cooler, pushed me down on the floor, and pumped a bullet into the back of my head - execution style.

sentences.sentence: Also, the further an executive rises, the more he or she must deal with high-caliber people who know how to get what they want, are difficult, strong-willed and have a sharp appetite for power.

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 340 单元

pluralism
音标：英 /'plʊər(ə)lɪz(ə)m/  美 /'plʊər(ə)lɪz(ə)m/
n. 复数, 兼职
短语：cultural pluralism — 文化多元主义；文化多元性

alumnus
音标：英 /ə'lʌmnəs/  美 /ə'lʌmnəs/
n. 男毕业生, 男校友

heritage
音标：英 /'herɪtɪdʒ/  美 /'hɛrɪtɪdʒ/
n. 遗产, 继承权
短语：cultural heritage — 文化遗产
短语：natural heritage — 自然遗产
短语：heritage preservation — 遗产维护
短语：heritage foundation — 传统基金会；遗产基金会
例句：the importance of preserving the national heritage
保护民族遗产的重要性
例句：beautiful old buildings which are part of our heritage
属于我们遗产一部分的漂亮古建筑

tenet
音标：英 /'tenɪt; 'tiːnet/  美 /'tɛnɪt/
n. 原则
短语：company tenet — 公司宗旨；企业宗旨
例句：Non-violence and patience are the central tenets of their faith.
非暴力和忍耐是他们信仰的基本原则。

logger
音标：英 /'lɒgə/  美 /'lɔɡɚ/
n. 樵夫, 圆木装车机
短语：data logger — 数据记录器；巡回检测装置；数据自动测定

geochemical
adj. 地球化学的
短语：geochemical prospecting — 地球化学勘探
短语：geochemical anomaly — 地球化学异常，地化异常
短语：geochemical process — 地球化学酌；地球化学过程
例句：But there’s very little doubt that if methane emissions are as large as this, there will be severe biological and geochemical impacts.
但有一点很肯定，如果甲烷排放量确实是如此大，必将产生严重的生物和地球化学影响。
例句：He will have to make more observations and wait for geochemical analysis of the rocks Alvin has picked up to learn the answer to this question, but it's a start and Sinton is excited.
要揭开这一问题的秘底，他还须进行进一步的观测，并等待对阿尔文号采集的这些岩石所进行的地质化学分析结果。 而这还只是个开始，这不禁令辛顿倍感兴奋。

cloudlike
adj. 云雾状的
例句：Following an air burst, condensed droplets of water give it a typical white cloudlike appearance.
空中爆炸过去之后，经过压缩的小水滴使它看上去就像一朵正常的白云一样。
例句：The 'brightness' mode tends to yield cloudlike patterns, and the others tend to generate images that look like heat-maps or CAT-scans. Written by Juergen Nickelsen and Jamie Zawinski.
“亮度”方式常常生成云彩一样的图案，其它两种方式则常常生成热成象图案或者计算机辅助断层扫描图案。

aide
音标：英 /eɪd/  美 /ed/
n. 助手, 副官
例句：a presidential aide
一位总统助理

vegetative
音标：英 /'vedʒɪtətɪv; -teɪtɪv/  美 /'vɛdʒə'tetɪv/
adj. 植物生长的,植物人状态的
短语：vegetative growth — 营养生长
短语：vegetative propagation — 营养繁殖；植物无性繁殖
短语：persistent vegetative state — 持续性植物状态；植物状态
短语：vegetative cell — 营养细胞
例句：She was in what was described as a vegetative state.
她处于一种被称为植物人的状态。

quickest
adj. 最快的
例句：However, in some instances it is the quickest way to achieve a goal.
但是，在有些情况下这是达到目标最快的一种方式。
例句：They have to learn not only the streets, landmarks and hotels, but also the quickest way to get there.
他们必须学习不仅是街道，建筑物及酒店，而且最快的方式到达那里。

overgrow
音标：英 /əʊvə'grəʊ/  美 /'ovɚ,gro/
v. 长满
例句：The big banyan overgrow of my day of day of a block limb, hang below brawny and strong limb full each golden orange.
一棵遮天蔽日的大榕树长满了枝干，粗壮有力的枝干下面挂满了一个个金灿灿的橘子。
例句：These products have a chance to potentially overgrow their "M" and "P" roots, because they can be used to build a backbone of the enterprise-wide SOA.
这些产品有机会增长它们的“M”与“P”根，因为它们可以用于构建企业范围 SOA 的框架。
例句：Go on the ridge of field of overgrow fireweed , one pace is flabby accurate meeting falls.
走在长满杂草的田埂上，一步不稳准会跌倒。

enlargement
音标：英 /ɪn'lɑːdʒm(ə)nt; en-/  美 /ɪn'lɑrdʒmənt/
n. 放大
短语：job enlargement — 扩大就业
短语：enlargement factor — 放大率；放大倍数
例句：enlargement of the EU
欧盟的扩大

downhill
adv. 下坡；向下
例句：She bent at the knee when she skied downhill.
她滑雪下山时曲膝下蹲。
例句：I mean really, once they eliminated the choking hazard, it was all downhill for me.
我是说真的，一旦他们消除了窒息的危险，那就都是我要走的下坡路。
例句：At that time our relations were going upwards, but since then they have been going downwards [downhill].
那时我们的关系是走上坡路, 此后就开始走下坡路了。

idiomatic
音标：英 /,ɪdɪə'mætɪk/  美 /,ɪdɪə'mætɪk/
adj. 地道的 成语的
短语：idiomatic english — 地道英语；合乎习惯用法的英语
短语：idiomatic expression — 惯用语；成语性词语
例句：He had the ability to write fluent and idiomatic English.
他能够写出流利地道的英语。
例句：the idiomatic richness of the Spanish language
西班牙语习语的丰富多样

reckon
音标：英 /'rek(ə)n/  美 /'rɛkən/
v. 计算,估计
短语：reckon with — 处理；对付；和…算帐；预料到
短语：reckon on — 指望；依赖
短语：reckon in — 把…计算在内
短语：reckon up — 计算；合计
例句：The expression ‘full moon’ means the fourteenth day of the moon reckoned from its first appearance.
所谓“满月”是指从新月初现算起的第14天。

chromosphere
音标：英 /'krəʊməsfɪə/  美 /'kromə,sfɪr/
n. 色球
例句：After that is the chromosphere, a layer that looks reddish because of all the hydrogen found there.
再之外是色球层，这一层由于存在的氢元素而略呈红色。
例句：The solar atmosphere above that consists of the photosphere, chromosphere, a transition region and the corona.
太阳大气则由光球层、色球层、过渡区和日冕组成。
例句：A star during most of its life is a main-sequence star, which consists of a core, radiative and convective zones, a photosphere, a chromosphere and a corona.
一颗恒星其生命的绝大部分处于主序星阶段，在这一阶段它包含一个核心、辐射区和对流区、光球层、色球层和日冕。

nonproductive
音标：英 /,nɒnprə'dʌktɪv/  美 /,nɑnprə'dʌktɪv/
adj. 非生产性的
例句：It’s a batch process, which means that there’s a fair amount of nonproductive capacity,” he said.
这是一个间歇过程，这意味着有一个相当数量的非生产性的产能，“他说。
例句：It weakens fundamental systems, it distorts markets, and it encourages people to apply their skills and energies in nonproductive ways.
腐败会削弱制度，扭曲市场，鼓励人们把他们的技能和精力用在不产生生产力的方面。
例句：This suggests a huge portion of the credit stimulus has been wasted on nonproductive investments, which in turn has implications for how much of that lending would ever be repaid.
上述情况表明，信贷刺激计划下很大一部分资金浪费在了非生产性投资方面，我们可以据此推断这些贷款能收回多少。

traverse
音标：英 /'trævəs; trə'vɜːs/  美 /trə'vɝs/
v. 横渡，横越
短语：traverse survey — 导线测量
短语：rapid traverse — 快速移位；快速横动；快速行程
例句：two minutes to traverse the park
两分钟横穿公园

grammar
音标：英 /'græmə/  美 /'græmɚ/
n. 文法
短语：english grammar — 英语语法；英文文法
短语：grammar and vocabulary — 语法与词汇
短语：generative grammar — 生成文法；衍生语法
短语：grammar school — n. （英）文法学校；（美）初级中学
短语：case grammar — 格文法
短语：universal grammar — 普遍文法；通用文法
短语：transformational grammar — 转换语法
例句：Check your spelling and grammar.
检查你的拼写和语法。
例句：the rules of English grammar
英语的语法规则

caliber
音标：英 /'kælibə/  美 /'kæləbɚ/
n. 口径, 才干
例句：Perhaps the first thing that students notice about their college is the caliber of their fellow students.
可能学生们对这所大学关注的第一件事就是同学的才干。
例句：One of the criminals immediately shoved a .38 caliber handgun to my head, ordered me to the cooler, pushed me down on the floor, and pumped a bullet into the back of my head - execution style.
其中一个匪徒迅速掏出一把口径为38毫米的手枪用力指著我的头，勒令我走到冷冻机旁，然后把我推倒在地，像执行死刑般从后面朝我头部开了一枪。
例句：Also, the further an executive rises, the more he or she must deal with high-caliber people who know how to get what they want, are difficult, strong-willed and have a sharp appetite for power.
此外，管理者升迁到越高的位置，他/她就必须越多地与更有才干的人打交道，这些人知道如何得到自己想要的，他们往往难以相处，意志坚定，有更强的权力欲。
